en: Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle with multiple steep‑roofed buildings and a round central tower, standing on a wooded cliff above a river. At the foot of the hill, beside the river, is an industrial complex or mill with a tall chimney and long gabled factory buildings. The foreground shows calm water with reeds along the bank; the sky is clear and bright. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
